zh.hook: 换软件，最怕重新录数据？
lines: 把原来的 Excel 表直接拖进来，不用改格式。
列名按意思自动匹配：DOB 就是出生日期，Cage # 就是笼号，Male、m 都会变成 M。
先预览再导入，哪一行会被跳过都写清楚，导错了还能一键撤销。
bullets: 日期、性别写法自动整理

en.hook: Switching software means retyping everything?
lines: Drop in the Excel sheet you already keep, as it is.
Columns are matched by meaning: DOB is the date of birth, Cage number is the cage, and Male or m becomes M.
You see a preview first, with every skipped row explained, and the whole import can be undone.

zh.hook: 这管样本，是哪只鼠的？
lines: 在 BioManager 里，所有数据都是连在一起的。
从小鼠身上取的肝脏、血清，在样本库里直接链接回这只鼠，点一下就回到它。
写 qPCR 实验记录时，输入 @mouse 16，这只鼠的基因型、笼号随手可见。
bullets: 记录本里 @ 小鼠、质粒、订单
点一下就打开那条记录

en.hook: Which mouse did this sample come from?
lines: In BioManager, your records are connected.
Liver and serum samples link back to the mouse they came from, one click away.
In a qPCR notebook page, type @mouse 16, and that mouse's genotype and cage are right there.

zh.hook: 查一笼的信息，还要跑回电脑？
lines: BioManager 可以打印笼卡、鱼缸卡、果蝇管标签，每张都带二维码。
在鼠房用手机相机一扫，这个笼子就打开了，当场就能改。
普通打印机和 Brother、Zebra 标签机都支持。

en.hook: Walking back to a computer to look up a cage?
lines: BioManager prints cage, tank and vial cards, each with a QR code.
Scan one with any phone camera at the rack, and that cage opens, ready to edit.
Any printer works, and so do Brother and Zebra label printers.
bullets: A QR code on every card

zh.hook: 质粒图谱，一定要用付费软件吗？
lines: 上传 GenBank、FASTA 或 SnapGene 文件，自动生成可交互的质粒图谱。
环形图、线性图和序列一起看，特征和酶切位点都能编辑。
每一管放在哪个盒子、哪个位置，也记得清清楚楚。

en.hook: Do plasmid maps need a paid licence?
lines: Upload a GenBank, FASTA or SnapGene file, and get an interactive plasmid map.
Circular map, linear map and sequence side by side, with features you can edit.
And every tube has an address: the box and the position it sits in.

zh.hook: 实验做完，还要一条条录进系统？
lines: 拍一张实验记录本，或者直接打一句话，发给你常用的 AI 助手。
它读懂你的笔记，找到对应的笼子和小鼠，在 BioManager 里整理成一份提议。
你看一眼，点批准，记录就全部写好了；不点，什么都不会变。

en.hook: Done at the bench, and now you have to type it all in?
lines: Snap a photo of your lab notebook, or just type a sentence, and send it to the AI assistant you already use.
It reads your notes, finds the cages and mice you mean, and turns them into one proposal in BioManager.
You look it over and press Approve, and every record is written. Until you do, nothing changes.

zh.hook: 给药前，还在按计算器算剂量？
lines: 方案只写一次，比如他莫昔芬每千克 75 毫克，第一到第五天。
每只鼠的剂量和体积按最新体重自动计算，每天早上提醒你。
体重曲线自动画好，组间差异自动标星号，一键导出给 Prism 或 R。
bullets: 体重曲线 + 显著性星号
导出 Excel 给 Prism / R

en.hook: Still working out doses on a calculator?
lines: Write the regimen once: tamoxifen, seventy-five milligrams per kilogram, days one to five.
Each mouse's dose and volume come from its latest weight, and you're reminded each morning.
The body weight chart draws itself, with stars where groups differ, and exports for Prism or R.

zh.hook: 一张柱状图加 t 检验，还要开 Prism？
lines: 在电子实验记录本里粘贴数据，直接出柱状图、点图或箱线图。
误差棒、t 检验、方差分析和多重比较自动完成，星号自动标好。
图可以下载成 SVG 或 PNG，数据和方法都在同一页。
bullets: t 检验 / 方差分析自动做

en.hook: Opening Prism for one bar chart and a t-test?
lines: Paste your numbers into a data sheet in the notebook, and get a bar, dot or box plot.
Error bars, t-tests, ANOVA and corrected pairwise comparisons are done for you, stars included.
Download the plot as SVG or PNG, with the data and methods on the same page.

zh.hook: 谁订了这个试剂？到了吗？放哪了？
lines: 订单从申请、下单到收货，在看板上拖一下就改状态。
到货时一键加入试剂、抗体或病毒库存，信息全部带过去。
快过期、快用完的东西，首页会提醒你。

en.hook: Who ordered it? Has it arrived? Where is it?
lines: Orders move from requested to ordered to received: just drag the card.
When the box arrives, add it to reagents, antibodies or viruses, with everything filled in.
Anything expiring or running low shows up on Home.

zh.hook: 不养小鼠的实验室，怎么办？
lines: 点添加数据库，用你自己的叫法：爪蟾叫 frog，住的叫 tank，一窝叫 clutch。
勾选需要的功能：交配、基因分型、体重、冻存。
几分钟就有一个专属数据库，不用写代码。

en.hook: Not a mouse lab?
lines: Choose Add database and describe your organism in your own words: a frog, in a tank, laid in clutches.
Tick what it needs: crosses, genotyping, body weights, cryo stocks.
A few minutes later, it's a database of its own, with no code.

zh.hook: 今天哪窝该断奶？哪些该剪尾巴？
lines: 每天早上打开首页，今天要做的事都列好了。
超过 30 周的老鼠、要断奶的窝、基因分型队列、该翻的果蝇、快过期的试剂。
还有三种布局：卡片、时间轴，和按走路顺序排好的冰箱视图。
bullets: 今天要做什么一目了然
断奶 · 基因分型 · 翻管 · 过期

en.hook: Which litters need weaning today?
lines: Open Home in the morning, and today's work is listed.
Mice past thirty weeks, weanings due, the genotyping queue, vials to flip, and reagents expiring.
Three layouts: cards, a timeline, and your freezers in the order you'd walk the room.

zh.hook: 几百管果蝇，靠记性翻管？
lines: 翻管时间跟着温度走：25 度每 14 天，18 度每 28 天。
每个架子一张格子图，上次翻、下次该翻一眼看到，过期标红。
翻完点一下 Flipped today，就记好了。

en.hook: Hundreds of fly vials, and only your memory?
lines: Flip schedules follow temperature: every fourteen days at twenty-five degrees, twenty-eight at eighteen.
Each rack's grid shows the last flip and the next one, in red when it's overdue.
Flip them, press Flipped today, and it's recorded.

zh.hook: 电子记录本，也能像纸质本一样签名？
lines: 想让一页成为正式记录，就签名：确认身份，内容存下指纹，页面锁定。
同事可以作为见证人签名。
要改只能修订并写理由，每个版本和签名都留在记录里。

en.hook: Can an electronic notebook be signed like paper?
lines: When a page should be your record, sign it: its exact text is fingerprinted, and the page is locked.
A lab mate can witness it.
To change it, you amend it with a reason, and every version and signature stays on record.

zh.hook: 边做实验边翻步骤，还要另开计时器？
lines: 实验方案有版本号，做实验时会记下用的是哪一版。
Run mode 用大字一步一步带你做，每一步打勾自动记时间。
步骤里写了孵育 30 分钟，旁边就有计时按钮，到点会响。

en.hook: Juggling a protocol, a phone and a timer?
lines: Protocols have numbered versions, and each experiment records the one it followed.
Run mode walks you through one step at a time, in large type, timing each tick.
Any step that says incubate thirty minutes gets a timer button that rings when it's done.

zh.hook: 实验室的日程，能自己排好吗？
lines: 断奶、基因分型、翻果蝇、试剂过期，都会自动出现在日历上。
实验时间线写一次，改第 0 天，后面的步骤全部跟着挪。
预约仪器时间冲突，会直接告诉你是谁占着。

en.hook: A lab calendar that fills itself in?
lines: Weanings, genotyping, fly flips and expiry dates appear on the calendar by themselves.
Write a protocol timeline once; move day zero, and every step moves with it.
Book the confocal, and a double booking is refused, saying who has it.

zh.hook: 批量改错了，Ctrl+Z 也救不回来？
lines: 勾选多行，一次改一批：改状态、加进实验。
每次批量操作都能撤销，而且不会覆盖别人之后的修改。
每条记录的每次改动都留痕：谁、什么时候、改了什么。

en.hook: Changed a whole cage of mice by mistake?
lines: Tick rows and change them together: a status, or the experiment they're in.
Every batch can be undone, without overwriting anyone's later edits.
And every change is recorded: who, when, and exactly what.

zh.hook: 那个质粒在哪？那只鼠在哪笼？
lines: 按 Command K，小鼠、质粒、订单、实验记录一起搜。
每个页面都是一个标签页，可以拖动排序。
明天打开，标签还在。

en.hook: Where is that plasmid? Which cage is that mouse in?
lines: Press Command K to search mice, plasmids, orders and notebook pages at once.
Every page opens as a tab you can reorder.
And your tabs are still there tomorrow.

zh.hook: qPCR 做完，又要重新搭 Excel 公式？
lines: 把酶标仪读数粘到孔板热图上，标好空白和标准品，浓度按标准曲线自动算。
粘贴 qPCR 的 Ct 值，自动算出倍数变化。
全在实验记录本里，和你的实验步骤放在一起。
bullets: 孔板热图 + 标准曲线

en.hook: Rebuilding the same Excel formulas after every qPCR?
lines: Paste plate reader values onto a well heatmap, mark blanks and standards, and read concentrations off the curve.
Paste Ct values, and get delta delta Ct fold changes.
All inside the notebook, next to your methods.

zh.hook: 谁说实验室软件，都长得像上个世纪？
lines: BioManager 用的是 Mac 风格的界面，还有完整的深色模式。
每个人可以换自己的 App 图标：小鼠、斑马鱼、果蝇。
选一个颜色，整个软件的主题色都跟着变。

en.hook: Lab software that's nice to look at?
lines: BioManager follows the look of a Mac app, with a full dark mode.
Each person can pick their own app icon: a mouse, a zebrafish, a fly.
Choose a colour, and the whole app follows it.

zh.hook: 标签机买了，软件却不支持？
lines: 打印时选 Print on：普通纸张，或者 Brother、Zebra 标签机的尺寸。
标签按尺寸自动排版，冻存管标签也有。
Zebra 可以下载 ZPL 文件，或者直接发送到网络上的打印机。

en.hook: Got a label printer your software ignores?
lines: Choose Print on: a sheet for any printer, or a Brother or Zebra roll.
Labels are laid out to fit, cryo-tube labels included.
For a Zebra, download ZPL, or send the labels straight to the printer on your network.

zh.hook: 三周，二十个功能
lines: 三周，每天一个功能，谢谢每一个试用和反馈的朋友。
BioManager 会一直免费开源。
接下来做什么，由你们决定：在软件里点 Feedback，或者在评论区告诉我。
bullets: 评论区告诉我你要的功能

en.hook: Three weeks, twenty features
lines: Three weeks, one feature a day. Thank you to everyone who tried it and sent feedback.
BioManager stays free and open source.
What comes next is up to you: press Feedback in the app, or tell me in the comments.
